title: I Thought My Childhood Friend Was a Guy… Now She’s My Wife and It’s Going Too Well!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: As a child Shuichi played with Yuu, whom he took for a carefree boy. Ten years later they meet again at an arranged marriage meeting, and Yuu (Yuika) is a young woman who wants to marry him. The comedy follows the two as they trade friendship for marriage and newlywed life.
life_message: A marriage built on real friendship can flourish.
